verdict.rationale: Fin's own Procedures feature is documented to handle queries with multiple steps and business logic from start to finish, and the vendor says Fin handles multi-step queries end to end, which covers the multi-step troubleshooting half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows Fin asking clarifying questions, and all evidence is vendor marketing. missing for 10: explicit evidence of clarifying-question behavior, detailed docs on troubleshooting flows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, the agent asks clarifying questions and works through multi-step troubleshooting instead of dumping one canned answer

citations.quote: Procedures let you train Fin to handle queries with multiple steps, business logic and third-party systems from start to finish.
handles multi-step queries end to end
Fin over Email resolves everything from simple FAQs to complex threads with attachments and multiple recipients
